_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 40: 15-17 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he looks at where he wants to be this time next year and asks whether he made any progress spiritually and how things are, and mentions an interesting conversation the day before with a mega minister who called wanting to talk to him.
mentions.quote: did I make any progress spiritually and how are things?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a stated practice of annual self-review.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reports the mega minister's position, that he could keep preaching the word and his personal life did not matter because the word always stands by itself, and says he thinks that is a dangerous place to be.
mentions.quote: that is such a dangerous place to be
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is him applying a standard to someone else that this database applies to him.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he thinks there is an escalation through 2026, 2027 and 2028, and that he has been praying into what the Lord meant by saying you must be a learning church, noted down from the last video.
mentions.quote: you must be learn church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he says he does not yet know what the phrase means.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks how you keep bringing in the harvest, says it is deeper than that and concerns the plague, and recounts that while on the phone one of these mega ministers told him to give them this word.
mentions.quote: It's concerning the plague
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: another minister urging him to publish, with the word itself not given here.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw weather manipulation with great floods coming, that the Lord said weather modification and weather warfare and warned about it again, and that they would test it a lot in 2026 and 2027, naming Thailand, China and Vietnam.
mentions.quote: they would test it a lot in 2026, 2027 for weather warfare in Thailand
mentions.falsify_match: Documented cloud seeding or weather modification programmes in those countries followed by major floods.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Cloud seeding is already routine in China and Thailand, which makes the match easy.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not think they will see that part of the trade, but believes they will see the digital process happening, and that the implementation of the full manifestation of it will come with the antichrist.
mentions.quote: the full manifestation of this I believe will happen with the antichrist
mentions.falsify_match: A fully digital payment system arriving with an identifiable figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Marked as belief rather than sight, which is the honest framing.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the peace part first, before the great tribulation and the last three and a half years, saying the figure implements his scheme first and everybody likes him, everything is great, the digital is implemented and the chips come.
mentions.quote: He implements his scheme first and everybody is like liking him
mentions.time_phrase: before the last three and a half years
mentions.falsify_match: A period of peace and popularity followed by the mark.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Standard dispensational sequence, restated rather than seen.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord kept saying hold fast, do not lose your focus, keep your eyes on me because of all you are about to see, and that for all they will see in 2026, 2027 and 2028 they must keep their focus.
mentions.quote: he kept saying hold fast. Don't lose your focus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction, not an outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether he knows when the plague will hit, he says he believes it will hit in the fall, in November and December of 2027.
mentions.quote: the plague will hit in November and December of 2027
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic beginning in November or December 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: None in that window. This is the tightest version of the plague window given so far.

mentions.claim_text: He relays that his father told him Rick Renner said something he had not heard Renner say before, about not seeing the tribulation or any of the birthing pains, and calls Renner very brilliant about the word of God.
mentions.quote: even Rick Renner said which I've not heard Rick say this
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a second-hand report of another teacher's position, relayed from his father.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the bubonic plague, the black death, that they took the black death out somehow, found it and brought it in with AI, and that he does not know how they did it.
mentions.quote: They brought it in with AI
mentions.falsify_match: A Yersinia pestis outbreak traced to deliberate release.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He names the pathogen, which is more specific than earlier tellings, and says outright he does not know the mechanism.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a timeframe but is still praying over the year, that it was in the winter going into the fall, that he saw the span and a clock ticking in front of his face, and that the Lord said January, February, March.
mentions.quote: I saw the clock ticking in front of my face
mentions.falsify_match: An event in a January to March window.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The year is explicitly still unknown, and winter going into fall covers most of a calendar.

mentions.claim_text: He reports God saying he is going to shake it out in 2026 and that many ministers they see will lose either their life or their platform in the days ahead if there is corruption, naming the gold, the girls and the glory.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake it out in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Prominent ministers falling or dying during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Either their life or their platform is two very different outcomes counted as one hit.

mentions.claim_text: He is reminded of the weird twilight and the birds and deer acting differently with changed breeding patterns, says he still thinks about it, and that something is going to happen.
mentions.quote: the weird Twilight and the birds and deer acting different
mentions.falsify_match: Something connected to animal behaviour or unusual light.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. He says only that something is going to happen, with no content.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going tubing now, that he dedicates this time, expects listeners to be upset that it ran two hours, and thanks God for every question they have.
mentions.quote: we're going to go tubing. I dedicate this time to you
mentions.falsify_match: n/a
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is warning about what is trying to come concerning Maduro and an escalation of him, along with all these major events, and asks them to pray for the nation and for Disneyland.
mentions.quote: praying for our nation, praying for Disneyland
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at Disneyland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. A named venue with no act and no date, the fourth of that shape in six weeks.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they are praying for February 3rd, says there is something about the 3rd of February and something major about February 3 and the budget, wonders whether it concerns the budget, says he does not know, and mentions praying into 333.
mentions.quote: There's something major about February 3 and the budget
mentions.falsify_match: A budget event on 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without one. Third distinct thing now attached to February 3rd, after the Olympics and Pope Leo.

mentions.claim_text: He says the church can change things by warning of what is to come, that a storm is coming and many people are asleep but will wake up in 2026, and that 2026 keeps looking to him like a dandy of a year with political theatre and all the rest.
mentions.quote: 2026, I keep seeing it, is going to be a dandy of a year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a dandy of a year has no threshold.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it was terrible, asks whether it will happen and answers that he does not know, says he sees in part and is only telling them what the Lord showed him, and describes drawing his bride to his side and coming boldly to the throne.
mentions.quote: Now will that happen? I don't know. I see in part
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the see-in-part clause placed directly after the most alarming content rather than before it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reports a financial wealth transfer for what is coming, for the Antichrist to rise up out of the Middle East, and says he found that interesting too.
mentions.quote: financial wealth transfer for what's coming for the Antichrist to rise up
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable figure rising in the Middle East on the back of a financial shift.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Notable in its own right: the wealth transfer he has been praying for is here given an end purpose that is not a good one.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing Canada with the laws being pressed and all the things coming, that the Lord said very great religious persecution is coming to Europe, Canada and Australia, and says that after today's event he expects it to double in Australia.
mentions.quote: very great religious persecution is coming to Europe and Canada and Australia
mentions.falsify_match: New restrictions on religious expression in those countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He revises the expectation upward immediately after a news event, which is the mechanism worth noting rather than the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the door will be open for good measure pressed down and shaken together, and speaks of pressing in and believing for more in 2026, for the great wealth transfer.
mentions.quote: believing you for more in 2026, for the great wealth transfer
mentions.falsify_match: Reported financial breakthrough among the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes with all his heart that what they are about to experience in 2026, 2027 and 2028 is a great shaking to awaken, and that fearful sights will be seen to bring people to their knees, an awakening unto God.
mentions.quote: Fearful sights you will see to bring you to your knee
mentions.falsify_match: Frightening events followed by a religious revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The rhyme is doing the work, and fearful sights has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the devil as the accuser of the brethren at the top of it, petitioning the father concerning every single one of these things concerning 2026, and pointing to each of the pillars in turn.
mentions.quote: he was up petitioning the father concerning every single one of these things
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a heavenly courtroom scene.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that was the seven deadly going into 2026 and about keeping your heart right before the father, that he saw the pillars, and that Satan as the accuser went up and petitioned for every single one of them.
mentions.quote: that was the seven deadly and going into 2026
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the seven deadly sins as the framework for a year.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He works through what he says was shown, naming pride, greed, gluttony, slothfulness and lust, and needs someone to scroll back up to recover the rest of the list.
mentions.quote: Pride, greed, gluttony, slothfulness
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he has to be reminded of the items from notes on screen.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for his faithfulness to them through the year as they close it out, and sings a well known hymn about provision and daily mercies.
mentions.quote: I thank you that you've been faithful this year to us
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: thanksgiving, with the hymn described rather than reproduced.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it will go into Ireland, a social credit score on the cameras on the posts, that they will bring in what China does and bring it into these other areas, and that people will cry out.
mentions.quote: AND IT WILL go into Ireland. A social credit score
mentions.falsify_match: A social credit or camera-linked scoring scheme introduced in Ireland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Names a country the claim did not previously have.

mentions.claim_text: He says a shifting is happening that they will see in 2026 and that goes all the way to 2027, introducing these things, that this is all part of the beast system, and names crypto, saying to ride the wave.
mentions.quote: You will see in 2026 and it will go all the way 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A visible shift toward digital currency infrastructure across 2026 and 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such shift. Worth noting he calls crypto part of the beast system and tells them to ride it in the same breath.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will see all the shaking to awaken, that 2026 will be a year of great shaking, and repeats shake for 2027.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be a year of great shaking
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: shaking has no measure anywhere in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
